<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one carbon signal appears in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm): 26.41 ppm. The other aliphatic carbons (37.50 and 36.39 ppm) are likely methylene or tertiary carbons, not methyls. Therefore, the molecule contains a single methyl group.</thought>
